Impericon Festival 2027: New Band Wave with The Devil Wears Prada, Comeback Kid & More!

New band wave this Monday: On Friday, we already dropped a few hints across our socials, and you put forward some pretty solid guesses in the comments. Quite a few of you were spot on!

You can already see the final reveal on the poster. We're excited to welcome the following 10 acts to Impericon Festival 2027:

Friday:

  • The Devil Wears Prada

  • Comeback Kid

  • Holding Absence

  • Walls Of Jericho

  • Elwood Stray

  • Humanity's Last Breath

Saturday:

  • Dragged Under

  • Gideon

  • Half Me

  • Sun Eater

This brings our lineup, headlined by Lorna Shore and Beartooth, to 20 bands, with more announcements to follow. If you don't have tickets waiting at home yet: weekend tickets and camping passes are available on our festival page.
